source_of_truth: immutable run raw.csv and run-local probe_manifest.json

voltage.signed_area: trapezoid(V,time) on actual stored rows in [start,end)
voltage.peaks: stored-sample positive/negative extrema and their stored times

lobe_candidates.meaning: descriptive local-extremum candidates only; not an event/SFQ classifier

phase.unwrap: each P(...) column independently over its native stored order
phase.cross_check: same JJ, same run, same endpoint direction, same stored rows and window: phase delta/(2*pi) versus V integral/2.067833848e-15

stage_boundary_metrics: DOUT_Dk signed area, extrema, stored peak times
previous C_(k-1) signed area and extrema where k>0
CBU A/B/OUT and T1_I signed area, extrema, stored peak times
S_k and C_k signed area, extrema, stored peak times
D0 sJTL BJ1 and DFF B1/B2/B7 same-JJ phase/voltage arithmetic
source/load/link current extrema and charge on actual grid
last relative-threshold lobe-candidate time and time-to-configured-clock as navigation only
